result.reason: The operative clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber, workers’ compensation, and certificate requirements. However, requiring every policy—including CGL and workers’ compensation—to remain in force for one year after the term exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored; any post-termination requirement should ordinarily be limited to claims-made E&O and cyber/privacy coverage. The clause also would be clearer if it expressly referenced privacy liability. The unrelated force majeure language is preserved.
